'''Mike Fitzgerald No Shelter''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Mike Fitzgerald]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/decks99k.htm No Shelter], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228072350/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/decks99k.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
